en.question: A plugin used by your team pins a dependency that conflicts with another plugin's requirement. What is the most sustainable resolution?

options.text: Manually edit the installed plugin files to relax the version constraint.
options.note: Local edits are silently lost on the next update and cannot be maintained.

options.text: Install the plugins into isolated environments with independent resolution.
Remove the pin from both plugins so the newest version is always installed.
options.note: Removing pins invites the breakage the pins were added to prevent.

options.text: Keep both and document the conflict so developers know which to avoid.
options.note: Documents the problem without resolving it and relies on vigilance.

en.explanation: Isolation lets incompatible requirements coexist without either being modified, so upgrades stay clean and nothing has to be re-patched after every release.
